title: Campbell County School District Planetarium

services.name: CCSD Planetarium
services.desc: My first memorable visit to a planetarium was in fifth grade. My teacher brought in an inflatable planetarium which seemed to take up half the gym. We had to sit on the edges so the dome could stay filled with air. She showed us constellations and told us their stories. I didn’t see a single constellation, but loved the stories. I was already a big fan of greek mythology so I began studying the constellations and fell in love with astronomy. I got to visit many other planetariums as a student which continued to inspire me.
